# How much does it cost to hire a company to build an AI agent?

As of October 2026, **a custom AI agent typically costs \$10,000–\$80,000 for a business-ready, single-workflow solution**, while complex enterprise systems can cost \$100,000–\$500,000 or more. You can also find smaller, fixed-price projects starting around \$3,000–\$10,000. The biggest cost drivers are integrations, reliability, security, and the complexity of the work the agent must perform. [botgigs.com](https://botgigs.com/lp/ai-agent-development-company?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[fusionhit.com](https://fusionhit.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.intuz.com](https://www.intuz.com/blog/top-10-ai-agent-development-companies-in-us/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.nexeagent.com](https://www.nexeagent.com/services/ai-agent-pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

An AI agent is more than a chatbot: it can access company data, use software tools, complete multistep tasks, and take actions within defined permissions.

## 1\. Typical AI agent development costs

![AI Workflow Automation Dashboard by Sharif Ahmmed on Dribbble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MZ3LSbT1fPJBaLNJlunwRnKKXpC9-5ktj2x9b_ztyyA9Ks-qFjZcxogQPT4eyQI0NB0-aGuKCGJmSn1r8yNac8L3lQXA1cbRsX8MuyK8wCZNNay23upQpZfXNmKA8Wv0tV7yUJGcZkafdpYed3Wvrgp2JOEi3DPr64ZXCvrewc5dncni3Bsp6E_aGzdqy0ny?purpose=fullsize)

**Basic agent or proof of concept**

## \$3,000–\$15,000

1–6 weeks, depending on scope

Examples: lead qualification, document extraction, email drafting, simple internal Q&A, or a basic automated workflow.

---

![AI Automation and Chatbots - MarTech Union](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qWVV-aPs0n9zMFoIbPYGBdIOYOml0PUybvyVVJh6HNbNdZI9dd3rWcbwEVc1dY_MwSNb2yT-Y_vGpDKdpEfLtw209WDvVZs0nU9S80DivKP3DdfN0v9_KLjEzbGJKqsnEZOgVrcHNOLxbmi4bXTKIMYqEduV29QAwnjNSUEaSBaGTbA-EbsYbM2vYuorTgMN?purpose=fullsize)

**Business-ready custom agent**

## \$15,000–\$50,000

Approximately 1–3 months

Examples: an AI sales assistant connected to a CRM, a customer-support agent, or an agent that processes documents and updates business systems.

---

![Enterprise AI Agents & Orchestration Systems | ADSP](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qoSSk5qqhpuF77McG0LXXXL-bfsJv1DWVlsl_HI3sB4fUtIfSrFuhnGNQ5qAAwVxD1pcWBAynECyzjlSmy2Eyt1Vgc1eeG4PhWaPEVDceWg2cUDqJP1PFJwo5cGcoAElJvwf_EPRyrNNNbibUVNnIHwIl0Ksn1nFcAcIsZ_H3AUtetksTdWb3FXGefR6IyXE?purpose=fullsize)

**Advanced or multi-agent system**

## \$50,000–\$150,000+

Approximately 3–6+ months

Examples: agents coordinating across departments, complex data retrieval, approval workflows, audit trails, and multiple enterprise integrations.

---

![A how-to guide to design an enterprise Genai platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OUmmBN4Q_PuQjUvHWU3zaQw77uNGdnoDrDsgD0r34m3z1Q2W7spKQjKPWmYTxAFvnYy9jqvXjXPO8o8srm_SMas13sL9FCqeS0ejNsEMd5DOcHUgW19YnQ-qCkpvUMiR1000qlApX2TYR8_6kX-D03FD5xIc9G1Y-WgT68TkyiEgV5WL7LXCiLz3anJTI5Lz?purpose=fullsize)

**Enterprise-scale AI platform**

## \$150,000–\$500,000+

Often 6–12 months or longer

Examples: company-wide AI systems, highly regulated workflows, multiple specialized agents, and extensive security and governance.

These are indicative budgeting ranges synthesized from published 2026 cost guides, not guaranteed quotes. Individual projects can fall outside these bands. Remember to budget separately for ongoing expenses\:

- **AI model usage and cloud hosting\:** depend on volume and model choice.
- **Maintenance and monitoring\:** a rough initial allowance is \$500–\$3,000 per month for a smaller system, potentially much more for enterprise deployments. ## 3\. Which company should you hire?

My practical recommendation\:

| Your situation | Start by contacting |
|--------|--------|
| Budget under \$10,000 | MTD Technologies or Expedey |
| One well-defined task with a fixed budget | QueryNow or MTD Technologies |
| A pilot that can expand into a production system | Arcesso or Expedey |
| Multiple systems and custom integrations | LeewayHertz or Azumo |
| Enterprise-wide deployment | EPAM or Accenture |


For a first project, I'd generally avoid committing \$100,000 or more before validating one workflow. A narrowly scoped pilot makes it easier to measure accuracy, time saved, and actual return on investment.

## 4\. What to ask before signing a contract

Use these questions when requesting proposals from three or four firms\:

- **Scope\:** Exactly which tasks will the agent complete, and which require human approval?
- **Integrations\:** Are CRM, email, databases, and other software connections included?
- **Performance\:** Will the vendor test the agent against real examples and agree on measurable acceptance criteria?
- **Ownership\:** Will you own the source code, prompts, configurations, and documentation?
- **Security\:** Where will your data be processed and stored? What access permissions and audit logs are provided?
- **Ongoing costs\:** What are the monthly hosting, model usage, support, and maintenance charges?
- **Exit plan\:** Can another developer maintain the system if you change vendors?

Ask each firm to quote the same deliverables, so you can compare more than just its headline price.

For a first project, I'd generally avoid committing \$100,000 or more before validating one workflow. A narrowly scoped pilot makes it easier to measure accuracy, time saved, and actual return on investment.

## 4\. What to ask before signing a contract

Use these questions when requesting proposals from three or four firms\:

- **Scope\:** Exactly which tasks will the agent complete, and which require human approval?
- **Integrations\:** Are CRM, email, databases, and other software connections included?
- **Performance\:** Will the vendor test the agent against real examples and agree on measurable acceptance criteria?
- **Ownership\:** Will you own the source code, prompts, configurations, and documentation?
- **Security\:** Where will your data be processed and stored? What access permissions and audit logs are provided?
- **Ongoing costs\:** What are the monthly hosting, model usage, support, and maintenance charges?
- **Exit plan\:** Can another developer maintain the system if you change vendors?

Ask each firm to quote the same deliverables, so you can compare more than just its headline price.
